original_annotations: On YouTube, find a beginner tutorial that teaches how to make the exact same small hand-sewn felt finger puppets as in the video. Open a tutorial whose thumbnail or demo clearly shows the same two animal characters made as finger puppets.

supported_claims.text: The released views show two felt finger puppets: a pink pig with a round snout and a white cow with horns and an orange snout. The white puppet is not a rabbit.
Early views show work on the pink pig; later views show work on the white horned cow, including fitting it over a finger. The appearance of the two toys supports the natural answer “the pink one”.
